cohort: The study used national surveillance data from the Haitian Unique Health Information System covering reproductive, maternal, newborn, child, and adolescent health (RMNCAH) indicators for the Haitian population.
finding: Most reproductive, maternal, newborn, child, and adolescent health (RMNCAH) indicators in Haiti significantly declined during the peri-COVID-19 pandemic period compared to the pre-pandemic period, with the pandemic and sociopolitical crisis as potential contributing factors.
